gloss: maritime disaster; shipwreck; accident at sea
notes:
A formal compound of {海|かい} (sea) and ⟦{難|なん}→難：00452_nan⟧ (disaster, difficulty). Used in news reports, legal contexts, and official documents related to maritime accidents. Japan, as an island nation, has specific legal and administrative frameworks for dealing with maritime incidents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海難|かいなん}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: maritime accident
- {海難|かいなん}⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧: maritime rescue
- {海難|かいなん}⟦{審判|しんぱん}→審判：03331_shinpan⟧: marine accident inquiry
- {海難|かいなん}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧: prevention of maritime accidents

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遭難|そうなん}→遭難：09510_sounan⟧: disaster, distress — broader, includes mountain and other accidents; also means being in distress
- {難破|なんぱ}: shipwreck — specifically refers to a ship breaking apart or sinking
- {座礁|ざしょう}: running aground — a specific type of maritime incident

definitions.gloss: maritime disaster; shipwreck; accident at sea
definitions.explanation: an accident or disaster occurring at sea, including shipwrecks, collisions, and other maritime incidents
